subject: Questions when kniting Rmd File with ggvis code.

messages.author: 39e35faa9acec652
messages.subject: Questions when kniting Rmd File with ggvis code.
parts:
Hello,
I'm trying to knit the following hello.Rmd File with ggvis Code.
```{r, echo=FALSE, error=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(ggvis)
mtcars %>% ggvis(~mpg, ~wt) %>% layer_points()
```
but, it doesn't work(The generated HTML File has no 'SVG' or other related tags, which i think it should have) by using the following R Code
knitr::knit2html("hello.Rmd")
The same things happen when i use the following R Code
knitr::knit("hello.Rmd")
rmarkdown::render("hello.md")
But, when i directly use rmarkdown to generate HTML file, it worked.
rmarkdown::render("hello.Rmd")
This problem confused me, because i thought the generate process is "Rmd->md->HTML".
And the reason why i want 'md' file is that i wanna use it in my blog.
Thank u,
Josh

messages.author: c2a4124666613378
messages.subject: Re: Questions when kniting Rmd File with ggvis code.
parts:
Hi Josh,

Try either:

    render("hello.Rmd", clean=FALSE)

Or include a settings yaml block at the top of the file with an explicit markdown output format:

    http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com/markdown_document_format.html

Cheers,
Keith
